# S3 (a8ea): Config-driven type mapping + type-granular skip

## Context / Problem
Epic 3d7a adds a generic, config-driven mapping seam (S1: `mapping_config.MappingLayer`,
axes `status_map/type_map/link_map/priority_map`, `SKIP="skip"`, `resolve_for_project`,
`validate`). S2 made STATUS config-driven; study it as the template
(`config.effective_status_map` at `config.py:77`; the `rebar-status:` stamp in
`outbound_labels.py`; reverse-map-free inbound `recover_status_label` in
`inbound_fields.py:152`). Ticket TYPE is still hard-coded: `LOCAL_TYPE_TO_JIRA`
(`adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py:40` = `{bug,story,task,epic}`) and
`EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES` (`config.py:13`), with three create paths silently coercing an
unknown type to `Task`. Because rebar carries more types than a target Jira may model,
distinct local types can collapse to one Jira type — lossy round-trip.

## Approach
Three outcomes for a local `ticket_type`:
1. **remap** — via a NEW effective per-project type map (mirror `effective_status_map`).
2. **skip** — per-project type-granular whole-ticket exclusion, extending
   `EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES` (`config.py:13`) via a NEW effective excluded set.
3. **FAIL-CLOSED** — an unmapped, non-skipped **syncable** type raises rather than
   coercing. Syncable is DERIVED: `get_args(TicketType)` (`types.py:23`) −
   `EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES` = `{bug,epic,story,task}` = keys of `LOCAL_TYPE_TO_JIRA`.

Round-trip safety: a NEW `rebar-type:` annotation label, **symmetric** with
`rebar-status:` and inbound **reverse-map-free** (recover the original local type from
the label, never by inverting the collapsed map — mirror S2).

New symbols (all NEW, marked):
- `config.effective_type_map(project_key, root)` and
  `config.effective_excluded_sync_types(project_key, root)` — mirror
  `config.effective_status_map` (`config.py:77`), resolved through
  `mapping_config.resolve_for_project` (`type_map` axis; `SKIP`→excluded).
- `outbound_labels._REBAR_TYPE_LABEL_PREFIX="rebar-type:"`,
  `_desired_type_annotation` (mirror `_desired_status_annotation` ~`outbound_labels.py:89`),
  `_diff_type_annotation_labels` (mirror `_diff_status_annotation_labels` ~`:114`):
  stamp only when the forward map is LOSSY (target does not reverse to this local type).
- `inbound_fields.recover_type_label` (mirror `recover_status_label`
  `inbound_fields.py:152`), gated by NEW `_LOCAL_TYPE_VOCAB` derived from
  `get_args(TicketType)` (no hand-maintained parallel literal); applied at the inbound
  issuetype site `inbound_fields.py:311-313` with the same "prefer label over raw" order
  as `recover_status_label` at `inbound_fields.py:326`.

## Surface-parity census (all VERIFIED in-repo)

### Finding 1 — where the status stamp diff is threaded (thread the type stamp identically)
The `outbound_differ` builders were split into `outbound_mutation_builders.py`. The
`rebar-status:` diff (`_diff_status_annotation_labels`) is threaded at TWO sites there:
- `_compute_outbound_create_mutation` (def `outbound_mutation_builders.py:37`): computes
  `annotation_mutations` at **:81**, merged into create `labels` at **:138**.
- `_compute_outbound_update_mutation` (def `:145`): computes `annotation_mutations` at
  **:276**, merged into `label_mutations` at **:281**.
Thread `_diff_type_annotation_labels` at BOTH sites, using the effective type map from
`_effective_status_map_for`'s type analog (per-ticket project resolution).

### Finding 2 — ALL consumers of the effective excluded set on the outbound path
`EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES` is read ONCE (`outbound_differ.py:377`) into `excluded_sync_types`,
then consumed at TWO sites:
- **`outbound_differ.py:430`** — per-ticket loop in `compute_outbound_mutations`
  (`if ticket.get("ticket_type","") in excluded_sync_types: continue`).
- **`outbound_differ.py:519`** — in `_compute_outbound_select_absent_gets`
  (the absent-GET selection filter).
Replace the single `.EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES` read with a per-project effective excluded set
and thread it into BOTH consumers (resolve per project key inside the loop, since a batch
can span projects; matches how status map is resolved per ticket).

### Finding 3 — ALL prefix tuples carrying `rebar-status:` must gain `rebar-type:`
Four independent copies exist (grep `_EXCLUDED_PREFIXES` + literal `rebar-status:` tuples):
1. `outbound_labels.py:34` `_EXCLUDED_PREFIXES` — re-exported at `outbound_differ.py:77`,
   consumed at `outbound_mutation_builders.py:136`.
2. `inbound_collection_diffs.py:88` `_EXCLUDED_PREFIXES` — re-exported at
   `inbound_differ.py:31`, read dynamically at `reconcile_check.py:96`. **(the copy the
   prior plan MISSED)**
3. `differ.py:105` `_BRIDGE_INTERNAL_LABEL_PREFIXES` (snapshot-differ drift suppression).
4. `inbound_translate.py:58` `_BRIDGE_INTERNAL_TAG_PREFIXES` (import-time tag filter;
   intentionally omits `"imported:"` — keep that, add only `"rebar-type:"`).
Add `"rebar-type:"` to all four so the reconciler-managed type label never surfaces as a
user tag, spurious REMOVE, or leaked local tag.

## Scope
- `config.py`: extend/keep `EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES`; NEW `effective_type_map`,
  `effective_excluded_sync_types`.
- `outbound_labels.py`: NEW type-stamp helpers; add prefix.
- `outbound_mutation_builders.py`: thread type stamp at :81/:138 and :276/:281.
- `outbound_differ.py`: per-project effective excluded set at :377→:430,:519; add prefix
  at the re-export.
- `inbound_fields.py`: NEW `recover_type_label`, `_LOCAL_TYPE_VOCAB`; apply at :311-313.
- `inbound_collection_diffs.py`, `differ.py`, `inbound_translate.py`: add prefix.
- Remove silent type-coerce default at the three create paths:
  `adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py:143`, `adapters/jira_datacenter/backend.py:86`,
  `adapters/jira/acli.py:282` — resolve via effective type map; raise fail-closed on an
  unmapped syncable type.
- Respect module-size policy (hard cap 800 LOC; target 200-500) — additions are small,
  no split expected.

## Testing
New file `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_type_mapping.py` covering remap, skip,
fail-closed, round-trip via `rebar-type:`, per-project variance, and all three findings.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `test_effective_type_map_default_equals_builtin` — no `[mapping]` block ⇒ effective
  type map equals `LOCAL_TYPE_TO_JIRA`.
- [ ] `test_effective_type_map_per_project_override` — project `type_map` overrides remap.
- [ ] `test_type_skip_excludes_ticket_both_consumers` — a per-project skipped type is
  excluded at BOTH `outbound_differ.py:430` and `:519` (finding 2).
- [ ] `test_unmapped_syncable_type_fails_closed` — unmapped non-skipped syncable type
  raises (no `Task` coercion) across the three create paths.
- [ ] `test_excluded_sync_types_still_skipped` — built-in `EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES` unchanged.
- [ ] `test_rebar_type_label_stamped_when_lossy` — collapsing types stamps `rebar-type:`
  ADD at the create AND update threading sites (finding 1).
- [ ] `test_rebar_type_label_recovered_reverse_map_free` — `recover_type_label` restores
  the original local type from the label without inverting the map.
- [ ] `test_rebar_type_prefix_excluded_all_four_tuples` — `rebar-type:` filtered by
  `outbound_labels`, `inbound_collection_diffs`, `differ`, `inbound_translate` (finding 3).
- [ ] `test_local_type_vocab_derived_from_ticket_type` — `_LOCAL_TYPE_VOCAB` equals
  `get_args(TicketType)` (no drift).

Test tier: unit
